summary: Frontend-only verification of the new desktop hover-dropdown MiniCart in Header. All 6 review-request checks PASS: trigger present, hover-opened dropdown with free-delivery progress bar at correct partial fill, item rows with line totals & remove buttons, footer total + 'В корзину'/'Оформить' buttons that navigate correctly, cart-link itself navigates to /cart, remove-button removes item without navigating, and console is clean (only pre-existing unrelated 403 analytics already noted in iteration_66).

verified_features.evidence: [data-testid='mini-cart-free-delivery'] text = 'До бесплатной осталось 3 288 ₽' (1712 of 5000, threshold enabled). Measured progress fill width ≈ 34.25% of track (matches 1712/5000=34.24%), partial fill as required.

2 [data-testid='mini-cart-item-{pid}'] rendered for pids 8cd5b1c5-... and aa56c8f3-..., each with image, name ('Фильтр топливный...', 'Фильтр масляный...'), 'qty × price' line (e.g. '1 × 1 450 ₽'), line total ('1 450 ₽'), and a remove button [data-testid='mini-cart-remove-{pid}'].
Dropdown text contains 'Итого' + '1 713 ₽'. Buttons [data-testid='mini-cart-view'] (В корзину) and [data-testid='mini-cart-checkout'] (Оформить) both present and visible.

verified_features.feature: Remove button removes item without navigating
verified_features.evidence: From /catalog with 2 items, clicked [data-testid='mini-cart-remove-8cd5b1c5-...']. URL unchanged (/catalog -> /catalog), removed item no longer in DOM, item count 2 -> 1, total 1 713 ₽ -> 1 450 ₽ in the dropdown footer. e.preventDefault()+stopPropagation() correctly prevents the wrapping <Link to='/cart'> from triggering navigation.

MiniCart.js line 76: `{open && cartCount > 0 && (...)}` — dropdown is gated on cartCount > 0, so it will NOT render when the cart is empty. Could not at-runtime empty the cart for this user without further interaction, but the guard is unambiguous in the source.

Only 3 console errors captured, all 'Failed to load resource: 403' on unrelated analytics endpoint (same pre-existing error documented in iteration_66). 0 React warnings, 0 JS exceptions. Other 4 console entries are React DevTools 'info' tips, not warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: MiniCart.js correctly stops Link navigation on the remove button via e.preventDefault()+stopPropagation() — good. Keep this pattern; without it, clicking remove would bubble up to the wrapping <Link to='/cart'>.

MiniCart.js relies on onMouseLeave to close — works as expected on desktop. There is no keyboard/focus open/close (no aria-expanded, no Escape to close), which is acceptable for a hover affordance but worth noting for a future accessibility pass.

The whole dropdown is wrapped inside the <Link to='/cart'> ancestor only for the trigger; the dropdown itself is a sibling of the Link (rendered after </Link>) so internal clicks (view/checkout/remove) are not accidentally inside an anchor — verified.

useEffect fetches /api/delivery-settings on every mount of MiniCart, which is fine (Header is mounted once per session). If MiniCart ever gets reused elsewhere, consider lifting this to a shared context to avoid duplicate calls.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing 2-item cart (~1 712 ₽) and the temporarily-enabled free-delivery threshold of 5 000 ₽ as configured for this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After this iteration the main agent will revert the free-delivery threshold (e.g., back to delivery_enabled=false or the production value). The remove test removed product 8cd5b1c5-7980-4765-9db9-8e309614f8c5 from user@demo.com's cart, leaving 1 item (aa56c8f3-... 'Фильтр масляный DAF XF 105 Hengst' qty=1 @ 1 450 ₽). If future tests require the 2-item state, re-add that product or use a fresh seed.
